# Free CRM Software for Startups & Small Businesses
HubSpot's free CRM unifies all your customer data on one platform, with AI that makes it easy to understand.

## Make Sense of Customer Data
Easily and quickly import your CRM data into HubSpot from another tool.

## Bring All Your Tools Together
Connect your free CRM to over 2,000 popular business apps through third party- and HubSpot-built integrations.

Automatically sync data two ways between HubSpot and dozens of popular third-party apps.

## Get More Done With AI

## Frequently Asked Questions
### What is CRM software?
When you use HubSpot’s customer platform, HubSpot Smart CRM is automatically integrated with your HubSpot marketing, sales, customer service, and operations tools right out of the box.

### Does HubSpot’s free CRM work with Claude and ChatGPT?
HubSpot offers [connectors for Claude and ChatGPT](https://www.hubspot.com/claude?hubs_content=www.hubspot.com/products/crm&hubs_content-cta=freecrm-faq-claude) that bring your CRM data into those assistants, so you can ask questions about your contacts, deals, and pipeline and get summaries and insights.

## Make Sense of Customer Data

With a unified view of every customer and powerful reporting, you’ll have all the insights you need to build better customer relationships at every step.

![A snapshot of a HubSpot report showing deal stage progress, highlighting various deal stages and how many deals are in each stage.](https://www.hubspot.com/hs-fs/hubfs/_en_use_case_01_make_sense_of_customer_data_2x.webp?width=2000&name=_en_use_case_01_make_sense_of_customer_data_2x.webp)

[**Contact management**](https://www.hubspot.com/products/crm/contact-management?hubs_content=www.hubspot.com/products/crm&hubs_content-cta=freecrm-contacts)

Create contacts, keep records up to date, log sales activities, and view communication history, all in one place.

[**CRM import**](https://www.hubspot.com/products/sales/crm-import?hubs_content=www.hubspot.com/products/crm&hubs_content-cta=freecrm-import)

Easily and quickly import your CRM data into HubSpot from another tool.

[**Deals**](https://www.hubspot.com/products/sales/deal-pipeline?hubs_content=www.hubspot.com/products/crm&hubs_content-cta=freecrm-deals)

Store, track, manage, and report on the deals or “opportunities” your team is working.

[**Task & activities**](https://www.hubspot.com/products/task-management?hubs_content=www.hubspot.com/products/crm&hubs_content-cta=freecrm-tasks)

Keep track of all the to-do’s and activities that help you build customer and client relationships, right inside your CRM.

[**Pipeline management**](https://www.hubspot.com/products/crm/pipeline-management?hubs_content=www.hubspot.com/products/crm&hubs_content-cta=freecrm-pipeline)

Visualize your entire sales cycle, assign tasks, and predict future revenue based on how likely deals and clients will close.

[**Reporting dashboard**](https://www.hubspot.com/products/reporting-dashboards?hubs_content=www.hubspot.com/products/crm&hubs_content-cta=freecrm-reporting)

Create a single source of truth for all your marketing, sales, and customer service data, accessible to your whole team.

## Bring All Your Tools Together

Scattered tools lead to scattered insights. HubSpot’s free CRM connects your essential business tools in one unified platform, creating a flexible foundation that adapts as your business grows.

![A visual showing a user setting up data sync between a third-party tool like Microsoft Dynamics 365 so data flows between Microsoft Dynamics and HubSpot.](https://www.hubspot.com/hs-fs/hubfs/_en_use_case_02_unify_tech_stack_2x.webp?width=1780&height=1300&name=_en_use_case_02_unify_tech_stack_2x.webp)

[**HubSpot Marketplace**](https://ecosystem.hubspot.com/marketplace/apps?hubs_content=www.hubspot.com/products/crm&hubs_content-cta=freecrm-apps)

Connect your free CRM to over 2,000 popular business apps through third party- and HubSpot-built integrations.

[**Data sync**](https://www.hubspot.com/products/data-sync?hubs_content=www.hubspot.com/products/crm&hubs_content-cta=freecrm-datasync)

Say goodbye to siloed data. Automatically sync data two ways between HubSpot and dozens of popular third-party apps.

[**User management**](https://www.hubspot.com/products/user-permissions?hubs_content=www.hubspot.com/products/crm&hubs_content-cta=freecrm-users)

Control user permissions for CRM records, content, and tools so each user has access to the right assets.

[**Ticketing**](https://www.hubspot.com/products/service/ticketing-system?hubs_content=www.hubspot.com/products/crm&hubs_content-cta=freecrm-tickets)

Log customer issues as tickets that can then be assigned, prioritized, and tracked in one shared inbox for your whole team.

[**Payment links**](https://www.hubspot.com/products/commerce/payment-links?hubs_content=www.hubspot.com/products/crm&hubs_content-cta=freecrm-payments)

Centralize commerce in your CRM. Easily create and share payment links to get paid faster.

[**HubSpot mobile app**](https://www.hubspot.com/products/mobile?hubs_content=www.hubspot.com/products/crm&hubs_content-cta=freecrm-mobile)

Access your HubSpot CRM on the go and never miss a task, reminder, or notification. Available for iOS and Android.

## Get More Done With AI

Say hi to your digital teammate. With AI tools woven throughout HubSpot's free CRM, you’ll automate routine tasks, surface customer insights, and accelerate your growth.

![A visual showing a list of contacts and their emails in the HubSpot CRM, with Breeze Copilot overlayed with the prompt, ](https://www.hubspot.com/hs-fs/hubfs/_en_use_case_03_get_more_done_with_ai_productivity_tools_4x.webp?width=2000&name=_en_use_case_03_get_more_done_with_ai_productivity_tools_4x.webp)

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is CRM software?

CRM (customer relationship management) software is a customer database that stores every interaction, including contacts, deals, emails, calls, and tickets, in one shared system so sales, marketing, and service teams can track relationships and close more deals. Modern CRMs like HubSpot also use AI to summarize records, draft emails, and prep for sales calls.

When you use HubSpot’s customer platform, HubSpot Smart CRM is automatically integrated with your HubSpot marketing, sales, customer service, and operations tools right out of the box. This makes it easy to optimize and personalize your campaigns and processes with data from your CRM, which leads to more powerful and impactful work from your teams — and a much better experience for your customers.

### What are popular free CRM software features?

HubSpot’s free CRM includes all of the following popular features (and more!):

- Contact deal and task management
- Email tracking and engagement notifications
- Email templates and scheduling
- Document sharing
- Meeting scheduling
- Live chat
- Sales quotes
- Breeze Assistant
- Reporting dashboards

### How much does CRM software cost?

You can use HubSpot’s free CRM tools at no cost. With up to two users, 1,000 contacts, and no limits on customer data, HubSpot’s free CRM functionality is 100% free, with no expiration date.

More advanced CRM features are available in the premium editions of our software. [Learn more about HubSpot’s premium CRM features and pricing information](https://www.hubspot.com/pricing/sales/enterprise?hubs_content=www.hubspot.com/products/crm&hubs_content-cta=freecrm-faqpricing).

### What are the main functions of a CRM system?

The main functions of a CRM system are to:

- Consolidate and manage customer data
- Streamline the sales process by tracking activities and leads
- Increase collaboration by letting sales, marketing, and service teams share data and work together with ease
- Track and report on key business insights

### Who uses CRM software?

Businesses of all sizes can benefit from CRM software — from small businesses to growing startups to large enterprises.

One of the advantages of adopting a CRM is that it provides visibility across functions and teams. In other words, stakeholders and representatives from sales, marketing, operations, service, and leadership can use it to evaluate their individual contributions and collaborate cross-functionally.

### What should I look for when choosing a CRM system?

When choosing CRM and client management software for your business, you should consider the following points:

- **Ease of use:** Choose a CRM that will be easy for your team to adopt.
- **Scalability:** Make sure the CRM includes the features necessary to grow and adapt as your contact database and revenue grow.
- **Compatibility:** Look for a CRM that integrates with your existing marketing, social media, and internal management software.
- **Price:** Consider the cost of different CRM solutions.
- **Service and support:** Choose a CRM that offers high-quality customer service, resources, and tutorials.

### Does HubSpot’s free CRM include AI?

Yes. Breeze Assistant is included in the free CRM. It can research companies, prep for sales calls, and summarize CRM records. More advanced AI, like the AI customer agent, is available in [paid editions](https://www.hubspot.com/pricing/sales/enterprise?hubs_content=www.hubspot.com/products/crm&hubs_content-cta=freecrm-faq-ai).

### Does HubSpot’s free CRM work with Claude and ChatGPT?

Yes. HubSpot offers [connectors for Claude and ChatGPT](https://www.hubspot.com/claude?hubs_content=www.hubspot.com/products/crm&hubs_content-cta=freecrm-faq-claude) that bring your CRM data into those assistants, so you can ask questions about your contacts, deals, and pipeline and get summaries and insights. These connectors require a paid Claude or ChatGPT subscription.

# CRM Software That Updates Itself
The intelligent CRM that unifies your data and tools, automates the busywork, and gives every team the context they need to take the next best action.

## Get Your Team on the Same Page
HubSpot's Smart CRM automates routine tasks, keeps your data clean, and gives admins the controls they need to stay on top of everything as the team grows.

## Scale Safely With Connected Tools You Can Trust
### UI Extensibility
Build custom interfaces, connect your existing tools, and extend HubSpot with flexible APIs, so your CRM works the way your business does.

### Integrated AI Actions in Workflows
Combine HubSpot workflows with your favorite apps to automate processes and keep teams operating smoothly.

View more

Customer Proof

## Frequently Asked Questions
### How is AI used in HubSpot’s Smart CRM?
Together with additional built-in AI features, HubSpot Smart CRM helps your teams automate routine work, spot what needs attention before it becomes a problem, and deliver more personalized customer experiences.

HubSpot Smart CRM also enriches your contact and company records automatically, drawing on data from over 200 million buyer and company profiles.

### How does complete customer context improve the Smart CRM?
When it's accurate and up-to-date, AI features across HubSpot can better personalize content and actions to reflect how your business operates.

### Does HubSpot Smart CRM work with my existing tools?
HubSpot Smart CRM connects with over 2,000 apps through [HubSpot’s Marketplace](https://ecosystem.hubspot.com/marketplace/), including native integrations with tools like Salesforce, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Slack, and Shopify. Two-way data sync keeps records updated automatically across platforms. For custom needs, HubSpot offers open APIs, UI extensibility, MCP connectors, and Agent CLI so your team can build tailored integrations without losing data fidelity or creating security risks.

## Your CRM Just   Got Smarter

Other CRMs simply store data. HubSpot's Smart CRM helps you act on it, showing what your team should do before anyone has to ask. The result is a CRM your whole team can trust — clean and up-to-date data, complete context, exactly when and where you need it.

![Shows activity on a company record in HubSpot's Smart CRM, which includes an enrichment update that updated certain properties including employees, annual revenue, and more.](https://www.hubspot.com/hs-fs/hubfs/Imported%20sitepage%20images/Smart%20CRM%20-%20Company%20Record%20ReEnrichment.webp?width=567&height=425&name=Smart%20CRM%20-%20Company%20Record%20ReEnrichment.webp)

## See Your Customers Clearly

Stop making decisions with incomplete and stale data. HubSpot Smart CRM unifies your customer information, conversations, and tools with built-in enrichment and self-cleaning updates so your team walks into each interaction knowing the full story. With Smart CRM, you get AI outcomes you can trust grounded in your business context, in one easy-to-use platform.


![](https://www.hubspot.com/hubfs/WBZ%202025%20Rebrand/Icons/customObject.svg)

### Custom Data Model

Store any type of data in your CRM with custom objects, events, scoring, and calculations.

![](https://www.hubspot.com/hubfs/WBZ%202025%20Rebrand/Icons/enrichment.svg)

### Data Enrichment

Built-in data enrichment keeps contact and company records current and suggests updates to CRM records. Your data stays clean and actionable.

![](https://www.hubspot.com/hubfs/WBZ%202025%20Rebrand/Icons/AiMessage.svg)

### Data Agent

Ask any question about a customer, contact, or prospect — AI searches your CRM, calls, emails, documents, and the web to find the right answer. Reps walk into calls caught up, with complete customer context.

![](https://www.hubspot.com/hubfs/WBZ%202025%20Rebrand/Icons/ArtificialIntelligence.svg)

### Self-Cleaning CRM

Get important information on CRM records, automatically fix data issues, and highlight what matters most about your customers and deals. All the context you need, where and when you need it.

![](https://www.hubspot.com/hubfs/WBZ%202025%20Rebrand/Icons/listView.svg)

### Dashboards & Reporting

View marketing, sales, and service data in one customizable place, so every team has the visibility they need to make faster, more confident decisions.

![](https://www.hubspot.com/hubfs/WBZ%202025%20Rebrand/Icons/twoFAOutline.svg)

### Sensitive Data

Securely store customer data with encryption and precise access controls. Built-in compliance gives every team the access they need, keeps bad actors out, and meets government regulations.

View more


![SUI of hubspot's smart crm showing data quality](https://www.hubspot.com/hs-fs/hubfs/Data%20Quality%20Tools.png?width=567&height=425&name=Data%20Quality%20Tools.png)

## Get Your Team on the Same Page

Unlike external AI tools, your business data never leaves HubSpot, so it stays secure and under your control. HubSpot's Smart CRM automates routine tasks, keeps your data clean, and gives admins the controls they need to stay on top of everything as the team grows.

![](https://www.hubspot.com/hubfs/WBZ%202025%20Rebrand/Icons/workflows.svg)

### Workflows

Automate tasks and customer communications with intelligent workflows that trigger based on customer behavior and agent actions.

![](https://www.hubspot.com/hubfs/WBZ%202025%20Rebrand/Icons/reports.svg)

### Custom Reporting

Turn data into insights with flexible reports that track everything from deal progression to revenue attribution.

![](https://www.hubspot.com/hubfs/WBZ%202025%20Rebrand/Icons/rotateLeads.svg)

### Security and Governance

Give every team member the exact access they need. Precise permissions, 2FA, SSO, and SOC2 compliance mean your IT and security teams are aligned.

![](https://www.hubspot.com/hubfs/WBZ%202025%20Rebrand/Icons/numberList.svg)

### Centralized Audit Log

Track every action taken by humans, automations, integrations, and AI for transparency and accountability.

![](https://www.hubspot.com/hubfs/WBZ%202025%20Rebrand/Icons/Duplicate.svg)

### Automatic Duplicate Detection

Use AI to automatically identify and merge duplicate records, keeping your database clean and accurate.

![](https://www.hubspot.com/hubfs/WBZ%202025%20Rebrand/Icons/tasks.svg)

### Project Management (Beta)

Keep customer projects and CRM data in the same place. Coordinate across teams, track progress, and automate handoffs, without switching tools or losing context.

View more


![Shows a handful of connector apps that can be integrated with HubSpot, including Zapier, Workato, Make, and Skyvia, sorted by most installed apps.](https://www.hubspot.com/hs-fs/hubfs/Imported%20sitepage%20images/Smart%20CRM%20-%20Integrations%20App%20Marketplace.webp?width=567&height=426&name=Smart%20CRM%20-%20Integrations%20App%20Marketplace.webp)

## Scale Safely With Connected Tools You Can Trust

No more switching between systems or reconciling data across disconnected tools. HubSpot's Smart CRM connects your apps, syncs your data, and integrates with your existing tools, so your agents, workflows, and data all work from the same source of truth.


![](https://www.hubspot.com/hubfs/WBZ%202025%20Rebrand/Icons/integrations.svg)

### HubSpot Marketplace

Connect your CRM to over 2,000 popular business apps through third-party and HubSpot-built integrations.

![](https://www.hubspot.com/hubfs/WBZ%202025%20Rebrand/Icons/dataSync.svg)

### Data Sync

Automatically sync data two ways between HubSpot and dozens of popular third-party apps.

![](https://www.hubspot.com/hubfs/WBZ%202025%20Rebrand/Icons/test.svg)

### Sandbox Test Account

Safely test changes and functionalities in a sandbox environment before they go live.

![](https://www.hubspot.com/hubfs/WBZ%202025%20Rebrand/Icons/dragAndDropLayout.svg)

### Custom CRM Interface Configuration

Match the layout of your CRM data to your team’s unique needs to ensure your team sees the right data.

![](https://www.hubspot.com/hubfs/WBZ%202025%20Rebrand/Icons/customModules.svg)

### UI Extensibility

Build custom interfaces, connect your existing tools, and extend HubSpot with flexible APIs, so your CRM works the way your business does.

![](https://www.hubspot.com/hubfs/WBZ%202025%20Rebrand/Icons/sequences.svg)

### Integrated AI Actions in Workflows

Combine HubSpot workflows with your favorite apps to automate processes and keep teams operating smoothly.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is a smart CRM?

CRM software that updates itself is more than a place to store data — it helps you act on it. It’s an AI-powered context engine that uses machine learning and natural language processing to automate routine sales tasks, surface insights from customer data, progress deals, and recommend next best actions — without requiring manual data fixes or complex automation. Unlike a traditional CRM with a bolt-on AI layer, HubSpot's AI is native to our agentic customer platform, so intelligence is built into everything you need to do, from day one. Every AI-driven update stays visible, editable, and under human control.

### How does HubSpot Smart CRM work with HubSpot’s core products?

HubSpot’s agentic customer platform is made up of several premium products to help you engage with customers: Marketing Hub, Sales Hub, Service Hub, Content Hub, Data Hub, and Revenue Hub.

Each product in the platform has a built-in connection to HubSpot Smart CRM, a foundational database that provides you with clear insight into every contact at each stage in their customer journey. Although our products are powerful on their own, they're most effective when used together.

### How can I purchase HubSpot Smart CRM?

HubSpot Smart CRM is available in one of two ways:

- As a standalone product, either as Smart CRM Professional (starting at $50/mo per seat) or Smart CRM Enterprise (starting at $75/mo per seat).
- As part of your purchase of another HubSpot product subscription. All core seats purchased for other HubSpot products automatically include access to Smart CRM features at the purchased edition (e.g., Starter, Professional, or Enterprise).

No matter which option you choose, you can always give more members of your team access to Smart CRM features by purchasing additional seats. You can also start using HubSpot’s free CRM tools and upgrade to one of our premium products for additional Smart CRM functionality whenever you’re ready.

### How is AI used in HubSpot’s Smart CRM?

Smart CRM's AI analyzes data across your calls, meetings, emails, and the web to tell your team what needs attention. [Breeze Assistant](https://www.hubspot.com/products/artificial-intelligence/breeze-ai-assistant?hubs_content=www.hubspot.com/products/crm/ai-crm&hubs_content-cta=null) is your conversational AI companion for go-to-market teams. Optional agents are included throughout HubSpot, depending on your product and edition. Together with additional built-in AI features, HubSpot Smart CRM helps your teams automate routine work, spot what needs attention before it becomes a problem, and deliver more personalized customer experiences. [Learn more about building and managing agents in Agent Hub here](https://www.hubspot.com/products/artificial-intelligence?hubs_content=www.hubspot.com/products/crm/ai-crm&hubs_content-cta=null).

HubSpot Smart CRM also enriches your contact and company records automatically, drawing on data from over 200 million buyer and company profiles.

### How does complete customer context improve the Smart CRM?

Complete customer context improves HubSpot Smart CRM by giving AI tools a precise understanding of your business, team, and customers. When it's accurate and up-to-date, AI features across HubSpot can better personalize content and actions to reflect how your business operates.

HubSpot uses this context to power recommendations, generate content, and guide agent actions across your account. Your context stays in your portal and is never shared externally. You decide what HubSpot's AI knows, and you can update or remove it at any time. [Learn how context home works](https://www.hubspot.com/products/artificial-intelligence/context-home?hubs_content=www.hubspot.com/products/crm/ai-crm&hubs_content-cta=null).

### What data does HubSpot Smart CRM store, and is it secure?

HubSpot Smart CRM includes robust governance features to keep your data secure. Unlike disconnected LLMs or AI point solutions, it stores contact and company records, pipeline data, communication history (emails, calls, meetings), custom objects, and behavioral data in one place. Sensitive data — including financial details and personal identification — is protected with encryption at rest and in transit, precise field-level access controls, and built-in compliance support. HubSpot also maintains SOC 2 compliance and supports single sign-on (SSO) and two-factor authentication (2FA) for enterprise security requirements.

### Does HubSpot Smart CRM work with my existing tools?

HubSpot Smart CRM connects with over 2,000 apps through [HubSpot’s Marketplace](https://ecosystem.hubspot.com/marketplace/), including native integrations with tools like Salesforce, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Slack, and Shopify. Two-way data sync keeps records updated automatically across platforms. For custom needs, HubSpot offers open APIs, UI extensibility, MCP connectors, and Agent CLI so your team can build tailored integrations without losing data fidelity or creating security risks. Most teams see full integration set up in days, not months.

### Can HubSpot Smart CRM replace multiple point solutions?

Yes. HubSpot is designed as an agentic platform, not a collection of integrations. HubSpot’s Smart CRM can replace standalone tools for email sequencing, lead scoring, conversation intelligence, revenue forecasting, and customer data enrichment — because HubSpot’s AI operates across all of these from a single, shared context layer. For enterprise teams managing a growing stack of point solutions, consolidation through HubSpot may reduce per-seat costs and eliminate the data sync problems that cause AI tools to underperform.
